DIY Accounting Submit

Free tools

Checkers, calculators and tables for Making Tax Digital, VAT and company filing. Each one works without signing in.

Each tool on this page opens without signing in. Filing a return or company accounts needs an account.

  • MTD Income Tax checker

    Answer a few questions to learn whether Making Tax Digital for Income Tax applies to you, and the date you start.

  • VAT return due date and penalty points calculator

    Enter a VAT period end and see the due date, and count the late-submission points a return would add.

  • Company filing deadlines

    Type a company name or number and see when its accounts and confirmation statement are due.

  • MTD calendar

    Every Making Tax Digital date for VAT, Income Tax and company filing, and which filings Submit offers.

  • Tax rates and allowances

    The current rates and allowances for VAT, income tax and company tax, each with its source.

  • MTD Income Tax checker for your own site

    The checker in a frame, with the one line of script that puts it on another site.

  • MTD VAT bridging software compared

    MTD VAT bridging tools sorted by price, each price read on the vendor's own page.

  • Company accounts filing software compared

    Tools that file micro-entity or small company accounts, sorted by price.

  • MTD Income Tax over £30,000

    What changes from 6 April 2027 for a sole trader or landlord with income over £30,000.

  • Connector for AI assistants

    Use Submit from an AI assistant that supports MCP: read a book, derive and prepare a VAT return.

  • Spreadsheets

    Accounting spreadsheets for a sole trader, a landlord or a limited company, in Excel.
